name: Dragonboat
description: Dragonboat is a product portfolio operating system that connects strategy, investments, customer insights, roadmaps, capacity, delivery and outcomes in one shared ontology. Product, portfolio and executive teams use its Strategy, Intake, Roadmap, Planner and PDLC apps to prioritize decisions, model tradeoffs and coordinate execution across their toolchain.
agentUseSummary: Dragonboat publicly advertises REST APIs, a remote MCP server and AI connectors for governed read/write access, but its public documentation does not disclose a distributable endpoint, authentication contract, tenant binding, scopes, tool or endpoint schemas, limits or revocation lifecycle. Relay therefore cannot safely expose Dragonboat actions until the provider supplies a supported customer integration contract for independent review.

blocked.label: Connect Dragonboat
blocked.description: No public supported customer authentication, endpoint, tenant-selection or credential lifecycle contract is available for Relay to implement.

blocked.label: Use Dragonboat REST APIs
blocked.description: Dragonboat advertises programmatic read/write APIs but does not publicly document their endpoints, schemas, authentication, authorization, pagination, limits or error contract.

blocked.label: Use Dragonboat MCP
blocked.description: Dragonboat advertises MCP access but does not publicly disclose a server URL, transport, authentication flow, tool schemas, tenant binding, permissions or revocation behavior.

blocked.label: Automate private Dragonboat interfaces
blocked.description: Relay will not scrape the Dragonboat app, replay private traffic, guess endpoints, reuse browser sessions or reverse engineer customer-only interfaces.

blocked.label: Expose raw portfolio access
blocked.description: Relay will not mount an undisclosed raw MCP/API surface or claim unbounded read/write access to strategy, investment, customer, roadmap, capacity or delivery data.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Dragonboat agent actions can be enabled until a supported customer integration contract can be independently reviewed and implemented as bounded Relay tools.

runtimeSupport.description: Dragonboat's advertised API and MCP surfaces cannot be converted to bounded OpenClaw tools without a published or provider-supplied authentication and action contract.
Dragonboat's advertised API and MCP surfaces cannot be converted to bounded Hermes tools without a published or provider-supplied authentication and action contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Dragonboat publicly confirms headless read/write access through REST APIs, MCP and AI connectors, but does not publish the server or API endpoints, authentication and tenant-selection model, scopes or roles, schemas, limits, audit semantics, token lifecycle or revocation contract needed for a safe distributable integration.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request or enter Dragonboat credentials and do not show Connect. In the separate provider-console acceptance task, ask Dragonboat to provide official customer integration documentation and a synthetic evaluation tenant covering endpoint and transport, authentication, tenant binding, roles/scopes, complete API or MCP schemas, limits, audit behavior and revocation; then re-run convergence from that reviewed contract.

evidence.supports: Dragonboat's official structured product information says the platform is headless by design and offers REST API read/write access, an MCP server and AI connectors across Strategy, Intake, Roadmap, Planner and PDLC data.
Dragonboat advertises MCP and AI connectors that let external agents read from and write to live product portfolio data, but the public page supplies no server, authentication or tool contract.
Dragonboat describes its shared portfolio ontology, five connected apps, AI assistants, governance and headless access through APIs and MCP.
Dragonboat documents per-user, per-account access, role-based controls, activity history, encryption, SSO and enterprise security, reinforcing the need for explicit tenant and permission binding.
Dragonboat sells contact-based Starter and Enterprise subscriptions, so Relay cannot assume public self-service integration entitlement or become the paying intermediary.
